name: nowitknows-codex
description: Learning for Codex: reusable skills, past chat search, personal memory, and background learning reviewed by an independent judge.

args: h=${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}; case $h in "~/"*) h=$HOME/${h#"~/"} ;; esac; f="$h/plugins/cache/nowitknows/nowitknows-codex/0.11.7/bin/nowitknows.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "nowitknows: no MCP server at $f; add the catalog as the marketplace named nowitknows and reinstall nowitknows-codex" >&2; exit 1; }; exec /bin/sh "$f" --codex mcp
